compare.title: Linework compared with typical AR tracing apps

compare.intro: Most AR drawing and tracing apps work the same way: your phone shows a picture over the live camera view and you draw along it on paper. The differences are in how they charge, whether they show ads, and how well the picture stays still. Here is how Linework compares with what is typical in the category.
rows: Free to trace your own photos; A$2.99 once for the full library
Weekly or yearly subscriptions are common, often around US$7-10 a week
Often locked behind a subscription after a trial
Picture lock and touch lock; focus lock on iPhone
Drifting or refocusing images are a frequent complaint in reviews
Lightbox mode: trace through thin paper on the screen
method: We read the store listings, reviews and 2026 roundups of AR drawing apps that appear when you search phrases like 'AR drawing app no subscription' and 'tracing app one-time purchase'.
The 'typical app' column describes patterns we saw across many apps, not one named app. Some apps in the category are free with ads, some sell a one-time unlock, and many use weekly or yearly plans.
Linework's column comes from its own App Store and Google Play listings.
notFor: You want to draw on an iPad: Linework isn't offered for iPad.
You want an image projected onto a wall with a projector: Linework shows the picture on the phone screen.
You want a full digital painting app: Linework is for drawing on real paper, walls or materials.
You want step-by-step drawing lessons: Linework's Sketch steps reveal a picture in stages, but it is a tracing tool, not a course.

alternatives.title: Alternatives to subscription AR drawing apps
alternatives.metaDesc: The main ways to trace a picture onto paper without a weekly subscription: one-time-purchase tracing apps, a lightbox, a window, the grid method and carbon paper. What to check before you install.
alternatives.intro: If you want to trace a photo or drawing onto paper but don't want a weekly subscription, you have several options, from apps with a one-time price to methods artists have used for centuries.
kinds: One-time-purchase tracing apps.
Apps that show the picture over the camera view and charge once (or keep core tracing free) instead of weekly. Linework is one of these.
Free apps with ads.
These cost nothing up front but often show ads, sometimes mid-drawing, and may limit tracing your own photos.
Lightbox or tracing pad.

A light pad under thin paper. Very steady and no phone needed; it costs a little and only works with paper thin enough to see through. A tablet or phone screen at full brightness does the same job for small drawings.
A sunny window.
Tape the picture and your paper to a window. Free and steady, but vertical and daylight only.
The grid method.
Draw a grid over the picture and a matching grid on your paper, then copy one square at a time. Slower, but it works at any size and trains your eye.
Carbon or graphite transfer paper.
Print the picture, lay transfer paper under it and go over the lines. Good for wood, canvas and walls.
A projector.
Projects the picture onto a wall or large surface; useful for murals, but costs more and needs a dark room.
lookFor: Is the price weekly, yearly or one-time? Check the in-app purchase list on the store page before starting a trial.
Can you trace your own photo for free, or only the app's templates?
Does the picture stay still? Look for a lock, a touch lock and reviews that mention drift.
Are there ads, and does the app need an account?
Does it work without the camera (a lightbox mode) for thin paper?
What does the privacy label say?
alternatives.fit: Linework is a one-time-purchase AR tracing app for iPhone and Android. Tracing your own photos with every tracing tool stays free with no ads; Linework Plus (A$2.99 once) adds the full library of 1,900+ templates and photo to outline. It also has a lightbox mode for tracing through thin paper on the screen.

linework.faqTitleTail: tracing photos onto paper with your phone
linework.faqDesc: Answers about Linework and about tracing with a phone: price, no subscription, keeping the picture still, photo to sketch, lightbox mode, iPad and privacy.
faq: Is there an AR drawing app without a subscription?

Yes. Linework has no subscription. Tracing your own photos with every tracing tool and 24 starter templates stays free, with no ads. Linework Plus is a one-time A$2.99 (local price shown in the store) for the full template library and photo to outline. There is an optional free 14-day trial that doesn't charge when it ends.
How much does Linework cost?
The download is free. Linework Plus is a one-time in-app purchase of A$2.99 in Australia; the App Store and Google Play show the price in your currency. There is no weekly, monthly or yearly plan.
How do I trace a picture from my phone onto paper?

Open the picture in Linework, stand the phone securely above your paper on a glass, a stack of books or a phone stand, then draw along the lines you see on the screen. Fade the picture with the opacity slider until you can see both it and your pencil.
How do I stop the picture moving while I trace?

Tap Lock so a stray touch can't move it, and turn on touch lock so your hand can rest on the screen. On iPhone, focus also stays put while locked. Keep the phone on a stable stand; most drift comes from the phone itself moving.
Does Linework project the image onto the paper?
No. Like other AR tracing apps, it shows the picture on your phone screen over the camera view. You look at the screen and draw on the paper underneath.
Can I trace without using the camera?
Yes. Lightbox mode shows the picture full-bright on a white screen so you can lay thin paper over the phone or tablet and trace it. No camera access is needed.
Can I turn a photo into a sketch to trace?
Yes, with Linework Plus or during the trial. Photo to outline makes line art on the phone in several styles with detail and line-thickness controls. Nothing is uploaded.
Is tracing cheating?

No. Artists have traced with projectors, lightboxes and grids for centuries. Tracing helps you learn proportions and line confidence; Linework's Sketch steps reveal a picture from big shapes to fine lines so you build it the way artists do.
Is Linework on iPad?
Not at the moment. On Apple devices Linework runs on iPhone (iOS 16.4 or later) and on Macs with Apple silicon. On Android it is on Google Play.
Does Linework have ads or need an account?
No ads and no account.
What does Linework do with my photos?

Your photos, outlines and drawings stay on your device, and image processing happens on the device. The App Store privacy label is Data Not Collected; Google Play's Data safety section lists app diagnostics, device IDs and purchase history.
Can I record a timelapse of my drawing?
Yes. Linework records a timelapse of your drawing and saves it to Photos when you choose. On iPhone it records up to 10 minutes with no watermark, and the guide picture isn't recorded.
What can I trace with it?

Your own photos, plus 1,900+ original templates with Plus: kawaii and chibi, tattoo flash, animals, sea life, fairy tales, flowers, mandalas, letters in 16 styles, and a Workshop of exact angles, joints and layouts for woodwork and trades.
What languages is Linework in?
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Hindi and Arabic.

alternatives.metaDesc: Ways to read a script on camera without a monthly teleprompter subscription: one-time-purchase apps, free apps, hardware rigs and simple tricks. What to check before you install.
alternatives.intro: If you record videos to camera and want a teleprompter without a monthly bill or a watermark, there are several routes, from apps with a one-time price to simple tricks.
kinds: One-time-purchase teleprompter apps.
Apps that keep the core prompter free or charge once instead of monthly. Cue is one of these, on Android.
Free apps with a watermark or limits.
Common free tiers stamp a watermark on recordings, cap recording length or limit how many scripts you keep.
A notes app or document scrolled by hand.
Free and simple, but you scroll yourself and your eyes leave the lens.
A hardware teleprompter rig.
A beam-splitter glass in front of the camera with a phone or tablet underneath. The most natural eye contact; it needs a prompter app that can mirror the text.
Bullet points instead of a script.
Keep a few key points beside the lens and talk naturally. No app needed, but harder for exact wording.

faq: Is there a free teleprompter app for Android with no watermark?
Yes. Cue is free on Google Play with unlimited scripts, steady scrolling, mirror and flip, a countdown and video recording with no watermark. No ads and no account.
Is there a teleprompter app that follows your voice?

Cue Plus adds two voice modes: Voice Pace moves the script while you talk and waits when you pause, and Voice Follow uses on-device speech recognition to follow your words. Voice Follow depends on your device and language support.
How much does Cue cost?
The download and core teleprompter are free. Cue Plus is a one-time purchase of A$2.99 in Australia (Google Play shows your local price). There is no subscription.
Is there a free trial of Cue Plus?
Yes, an optional 7-day trial you start from the Plus screen. It doesn't charge automatically, and your scripts and steady-scroll tools stay when it ends.
Can I record video while reading a script?
Yes. Cue records takes with the script near the camera so your eyes stay close to the lens, and recordings have no watermark. Camera and microphone permission are needed.
Can I mirror the text for a teleprompter rig?
Yes. Mirror or flip the text for a beam-splitter teleprompter.
Does Cue work offline?
The prompter, scripts and recording work on the phone with no account. Voice Follow uses on-device speech recognition, which may need the language resources installed first.
Can I import a script?
Yes. Import scripts with the system file picker. Word document import is part of Cue Plus.
Is Cue on iPhone?
Not yet. Cue is Android only for now, on Google Play.
Does Cue have ads or need an account?
No ads and no account. Your scripts and videos stay on your phone.
Can Cue make captions?
With Cue Plus you can export a caption file for your script.

backspin.faqTitleTail: the reverse singing game with a score
backspin.faqDesc: Answers about Backspin for Android: how the reverse singing challenge works, scoring, party mode, price, ads, privacy and iPhone availability.
faq: How does the reverse singing challenge work?

Say or sing a short line and the app plays it backwards. You copy that backwards sound as closely as you can, then the app reverses your copy so it plays forwards again. The closer your copy, the more it sounds like the original line.
Is there a reverse singing app that scores you?
Yes. Backspin flips your copy forwards and scores its sound, rhythm and length so you can see how close you got.
Is there a reverse singing app with no ads?
Backspin has no ads and no subscription. The first 10 scored rounds are free with everything on; Backspin Plus is a one-time A$1.99 (Google Play shows your local price) for unlimited rounds.
Can I play reverse singing with friends on one phone?

Yes. Party mode passes one phone around. In Copy it, each player copies a line and the closest wins. In Guess it, one player records secretly and the others hear only the backwards copy and guess the line. Up to 8 players.
How much does Backspin cost?
Free to download with 10 scored rounds. Backspin Plus is one optional lifetime purchase of A$1.99 in Australia. Saved takes stay playable and shareable without it.
What does Backspin Plus add?
Unlimited scored rounds, every challenge pack (950+ lines), all voice effects, party mode for up to 8 players, and unlimited saved takes and 30-second takes.
Can I slow down the backwards clip to practise?
Yes. Loop or slow down the backwards clip while you practise.
Can I share my reverse singing attempt?
Yes. Save takes on your phone and share a four-part clip: the original, the backwards version, your copy and your copy flipped.
Does Backspin upload my voice?
No. Recording and audio processing happen on your phone, and Backspin doesn't upload your recordings. You choose when to share them.
Is Backspin on iPhone?
Not yet. Backspin is Android only for now, on Google Play.
Is there a daily challenge?
Yes. Pick a daily challenge, or play a quick round or freestyle with any line you like.
